messages.author: 9d3ed194633adfe1
messages.subject: other blas/lapack libraries
parts:
Hello,

I was wondering if it is possible to use RRO with other blas/lapack libraries than Intel MKL, for example ATLAS, OpenBlas, Cula, or CuBLAS.

Thank You,

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: other blas/lapack libraries
parts:
Hi Manuel,

It's possible in the sense that you can reconfigure the build process to do so (the R Core Group provides some helpful instructions here: http://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-release/R-admin.html#BLAS ). Our latest Mac release uses the Mac Accelerate Framework, and we're researching the use of OpenBlas for other platforms. But we don't have any plans to build or test with any of those other libraries right now. If you try it yourself, let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
# David Smith
